result.title: $γ$-Scape: An Agent-Centric World for Mobile Embodied Intelligence
result.summary: Recent embodied agents construct and adapt robot behavior through executable programs, tool use, and interaction feedback. Studying these systems in mobile manipulation calls for physical worlds that connect agent-directed execution with its physical consequences and reusable interaction experience. We introduce $γ$-Scape, an agent-centric simulation and benchmark platform for mobile embodied intelligence. Agents compose motion tools and learned skills to carry out complete tasks that combine navigation and manipulation in a persistent physical world. BenchForge grounds structured objectives in physical task instances with instructions, reference programs, and goal evaluators, defining task goals while preserving agents' choice of valid solutions. An agentic collection harness further enables agents to produce demonstrations by carrying out contact-rich interactions through sustained control and physical feedback. Assisted reference execution and human guidance provide complementary experience. The resulting tool traces and aligned observation-action records support program refinement and policy learning, with common task-goal criteria for subsequent evaluation. We benchmark representative agent systems on complete tasks and demonstrate contact collection and trace-informed program revision. Together, these workflows provide infrastructure for research on embodied recursive self-improvement.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 γ-Scape：面向移动具身智能体的仿真与基准平台，让智能体组合运动工具与已学技能在持久物理世界中完成导航加操作任务，并提供任务实例、参考程序、示范采集与评测流程。
AI.relevance_reason: 属机器人仿真与基准基础设施，关注可执行程序与物理交互反馈，未涉及 VLM 内部视觉表示、latent 推理状态或证据筛选与停止决策的具体机制，故与本轮 LVR 主线缺少可核查的实质联系。
